hook: A hot Jupiter's transits vanished over seven years of TESS data, pulled off line by a hidden neighbor
hook_turn: pulled off line by a hidden neighbor
summary: TOI-2535 b is the first planet around a single star whose transits were watched disappearing, as its orbit tilted until it no longer crossed the star's disk. Seven years of TESS photometry plus radial velocities point to a Saturn-mass or larger perturber in resonance. The perturber is inferred from modeling and has not been detected directly.
title: A TESS Disappearing Act: The Vanishing Transits of TOI-2535 b
